scope: Current schema behavior examples. Fixture names are stable labels, not prescribed internal API types. One group may be proven by one table-driven test. Named subcases share the parent case ID; all their effects must be checked.

cases.requirement: Enumerated physical target keys and ownership
cases.description: Two plants, two sending churches, one network and two accounts; attempt each compound FK with valid and foreign parent IDs, invalid org kind and alternate-owner double shape. Direct SQL owner controls cover every non-tagged child→tagged parent, including exact organization assessment→job and same-plant merge inverse receipt; foreign scope kind/ID rejects even with an existing parent ID. Task due controls cover task.due_kind=undated with all due fields null; task.due_kind=date_only; task.due_kind=timed with due_date/due_time/due_at and confirmed timezone and chosen DST occurrence. Reject mixed/null shapes, mismatched wall/instant/zone and foreign or nested child Task parents. Direct SQL profile controls use the adopted plant and organization columns plus immutable effective plant_geography rows for locality; valid nullable field clears and malformed/oversize request controls follow their requirement boundaries; request controls reject unknown object keys and forged immutable fields. Assistant account-context controls use active explicit no-seat Discovery with conversation.tenant_id=conversation.owner_id; reject foreign account, mixed account/plant/org tuple and platform/affiliation context. Child-task SQL controls reject due/zone/date/time/instant, recurrence series/occurrence/predecessor and contact/outcome-hook values while accepting an undated unhooked same-plant child with nullable eligible assignee.

checks: Every enumerated valid same-owner insert/update succeeds; wrong owner/kind/null shape rejected by actual DDL/trigger. Catalog matches the current enumerated physical tables and documented fields, unique keys and immutability; no source-only coaching/background fields. Conditional serialized scope triggers and compound owner keys enforce those controls independently of runtime grants. A full one-level child Task retains its own assignee/completion history; Checklist names resolve only to the approved child-task row and history. Persisted job states and pre_launch_practice type are canonical, with display aliases explicitly mapped only. Profiles persist only closed typed columns; null clears only the selected nullable field, with no geography/timezone inference. Own-org Owner/Admin edits succeed with CAS/audit; Member/foreign/plant-role edits deny. Authenticated-self Discovery context reaches only its currently authorized own preplant docs/global Wiki/Discovery floor, zero plant/org grants or auth/secret/private-care model surfaces.

cases.description: Account private+shared records; plant owned objects/affiliations; request then cancel before/after30day fence; purge with dependent current revision links and scheduled effects; restore snapshot predating purge. Plant A contributes with B to saved organization run, assessment_fact, finding, assessment_contributor and protected lineage, linked feedback/export/artifact and a pending job. Request deletion, revoke A sharing independently, cancel with stale versus current grants, then purge and restore a pre-purge copy. Inspect lifecycle_witness pending_deletion, cancelled and purged with immutable request/revision, cancel_until, cancelled_at, live_purged_at and copy_expires_at; restore before request, between request/cancel and before completed purge.

checks: Normal access denied from request, cancellation-only proof; exact request revision arbitrates cancel/purge. Shared records survive personal deletion; private bytes/credentials purge. Plant purge preserves independent orgs. Current witness applied before reopening; copy expiry seven days from completed live purge never reset. No publicorgdelete. Request/revocation immediately denies affected copied NI history/current inputs and fences jobs/publication, withholds the affected derived current assessment and advances exact org revision. At plant live purge, whole affected assessment, assessment_fact, finding, assessment_contributor, linked reader_feedback and registered derivatives purge; surviving B/org remain and can recompute. No preserved body snapshot; separate minimum org receipt only. All source-containing recovery copies expire on A original live-purge+7-day clock, never org ownership/recopy/restore reset. Current pending hold denies normal access; current cancelled request restores only independently valid grants; current completed purge denies resurrection. Deadline and completed-purge timestamp CHECKs reject inconsistent state shapes, and copy expiry never resets.

cases.description: Concurrent tick claims, invocation loss before/after DB commit/provider acceptance, lease reclaim, late success, duplicate/out-of-order callbacks and unknown beyond provider-key window. Replay execution presentation labels pending/completed/blocked_unknown against canonical persisted ready/succeeded/reconcile; verify full child-task completion/reopen and recurring parent successor/child-copy fault rollback. Member owns parent A while child B belongs to another account: create using inherited current parent duty, reject explicit different-account/null assignee, then attempt B tick/reopen before/after reassignment. Owner/Admin valid explicit same-plant/null assignee controls succeed, omitted inherits parent. Member owns B under another assignee parent: valid child tick/reopen but parent edit forbidden. Race parent deletion with child creation. Import inert checklist definitions and complete recurring parent with completed child rows; fault each child/history/audit/intent insertion.

checks: One claim/effect/logical slot; stale generation cannot publish. Committed intent survives crash; unknown never blindly resends/newkeys. Signed deduped callbacks preserve truthful state; bounded retry/reconcile terminal path and bounded execution budget; fairness, reserved slots and per-kind alert tuning are deferred to measured-load proof. Aliases never introduce another job enum or turn unknown into success/retry. Proper child tasks have their own status/history; recurrence creates fresh child rows with cleared completion facts and no child due/recurrence/contact hooks, and any child-copy/history/intent failure rolls back the affected completion transaction. Parent is never auto-finished by child ticks; no competing live checkbox counter/state exists. Parent-duty child creation never substitutes for child-own-duty completion; current reassignment determines the legal actor. General edit/assignment/deletion remains Owner/Admin. Parent delete covers concurrent children and records their history. Imported/successor checklist entries are real fresh task rows with optional eligible assignee, no child deadlines/recurrence/contact hooks and no inherited completion facts. All source checklist aliases reach those operations; top-level reports exclude independent child credit.
